questions.question_text: Explain necessity and importance of water supply scheme.
Census data for a town is as follows. Year 1971 1981 1991 2001 2011 Population 35000 37500 43500 52000 57500 Estimate the population in the year 2030 by geometric increase method.
Mention any two chemical and biological tests for water along with the unit of measurement.
Define design period. State design period for various components of water supply scheme.
Census data for a town is as follows. Year 1971 1981 1991 2001 2011 Population 35000 37500 43500 52000 57500 Estimate the population in the year 2030 by incremental increase method.
State the HDL and MPL values as per IS:10500 for drinking water with appropriate unit, for pH, Alkalinity, Chlorides and Nitrates.
Differentiate between water treatment operations and processes along with examples.

The maximum daily demand of water for a town is 15 MLD. Design a 04 steps cascade aerator considering loading rate as 0.03 m2/m3/hr. Assume velocity of flow in collecting channel is 0.6 m/sec and height of aerator is 2.4 m.

A water treatment plant has four clarifiers treating 0.18 m3/s of water. Each clarifier is 5 m wide, 25 m long, and 4.6 m deep. Determine: i) the detention time ii) overflow rate iii) horizontal velocity and iv) weir loading rate assuming the weir length is 2.5 times the basin width.
Mention various objectives of aeration. Also discuss various limitations of aeration.

The maximum daily demand of water for a town is 150 MLD. Design 06 steps cascade aerator considering loading rate as 0.03 m2/m3/hr. Assume velocity of flow in collecting channel is 1m/sec and height of aerator is 3 m.

The maximum daily demand of water is 6 MLD. Design a plain sedimentation tank rectangular in shape, assuming the detention time of 4 hours and flow through velocity of 20 cm/minute. Also check the flow rate.
